text.text_excerpt: I love Patrick's Bar Vin! This is a place that I wish was more accessible from my house, although maybe it's a good thing that I need to work a little to get here. The staff, especially Patrick, is amazing, super friendly, a bit flirty, helpful, and so funny. They have a great selection of beer and wine from all over the world and love to discuss your preferences before you make a selection. The back courtyard is great when the weather cooperates and takes you to another place entirely. You feel like you have been transported to Europe in just the few steps out of the door. The inside is charming as well. It is filled with warm colors and comfy couches and big chairs to make it the perfec...

Good wine. Good cocktails. AND a really cool owner, count me in! I went to a gin tasting event at Patrick's Bar Vin on one of my first nights in NOLA, and it was love at first sight. The delightful courtyard greets you when you enter, and really takes you away from the craziness of Bourbon just around the block. The bar opens up into two main areas where you can sit inside, as well as the front courtyard AND the back courtyard, which has a cute fountain. You order drinks at the bar, but if you do order a cheese plate they will bring it to your table. Another great plus to Bar Vin is Patrick is always hosting special events, so it's another reason to check out the space if only to crash th...

Patrick's Bar Vin, I adore ya! Easily my favorite place to drink in the French Quarter and in my top five places in all of New Orleans. Time for an update because you deserve it. Patrick's is hardly a well-kept secret, but it truly feels like one! Denizens of Bourbon Street seem to miss it, which, let's be real, is a damn wonderful thing. I've met so many interesting people here, whether it be on a more quiet night or at one of the phenomenal seasonal parties (Patrick's Halloween party is my favorite).
